description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the "Activated Parameters Ratio(%)" and "Eval PPL." for four different model configurations. The x-axis represents the "Activated Parameters Ratio(%)" on a reversed linear scale, decreasing from 100 to 25, with tick marks at intervals of 25. The y-axis represents "Eval PPL." on a linear scale, with visible tick marks ranging from 11.5 to 14.0 at intervals of 0.5, accompanied by horizontal dashed gridlines. The "Transformer" configuration is represented by a dashed reddish-brown line with no markers, which remains constant at a value of approximately 11.6 across the entire x-axis range. The "Only MoHD FFN" configuration is shown as a solid grey line with square markers; it begins at approximately 11.4 at an x-value of 100, dips slightly to roughly 11.3 at an x-value of 50, and then rises to end at approximately 11.8 at an x-value of 25. The "Only MoHD ATTN" configuration is depicted by a solid dark blue line with circular markers; it starts at approximately 11.4 at an x-value of 100, increases to roughly 11.6 at an x-value of 75, and then rises sharply to end at a peak of approximately 14.3 at an x-value of 25. Finally, the "MoHD ATTN + MLP" configuration is represented by a solid light blue line with cross ('x') markers; it begins at approximately 11.4 at an x-value of 100, rises to roughly 12.05 at an x-value of 50, and concludes at approximately 13.2 at an x-value of 25.
